name: command-center
//private: Stays true even though the repository is shareable. `private` stops `npm publish` from ever succeeding by accident; it says nothing about who can read the source. This is a deploy-your-own hub, not a package.
description: One hub across all projects: agents queue work and decisions for one human, and read the answers back in one call.

scripts.//prove:all: typecheck is FIRST, and its absence was a real gap. `prove:parse` runs node --check over tests/ because that is where the backtick trap historically bit — but the trap is about template literals holding SQL or page-side JS, and lib/store.ts is full of them. A pair of backticks in a SQL comment there closed the literal and the only thing that caught it was tsc. Three seconds, and it turns an unreadable SyntaxError into a filename.
scripts.prove:all: npm run typecheck && npm run prove:parse && npm run prove:hooks && npm run prove:docs && npm run prove && npm run prove:negative && npm run prove:palette && npm run prove:ladder && npm run prove:use && npm run prove:layout && npm run audit && npm run prove:health
scripts.//at-scale: Two years of his own measured rate, so the payload can be looked at rather than estimated. --load, --measure, --clean. See tests/at-scale.mjs.
